To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed a dual-polarized dual-band antenna for the K/Ka-band, with a compact size and a low profile, that is easy to manufacture and can be used for satellite communication systems.
we designed a novel SIW-fed dual-band and dualpolarized lens antenna with high isolation and high gain at K/Ka band for satellite communication systems.
we have designed and developed a compact and low-cost dual-polarized, dual-band, and dual-fed antenna for K-band and Ka-band satellite communications systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, simulation and fabrication of a dual-band and dualpolarized lens antenna element for the K/Ka-band.
the design, fabrication and testing of a new antenna element for dual-band and dual polarized satellite communication.
the design, simulation and measurement of an SIW-fed dual-band and dualpolarized lens antenna for K/Ka band satellite communication applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed dual-band and dualpolarized lens antenna has the potential to be a key component for the development of future K/Ka-band multibeam satellite communication payloads.
the presented antenna element has a wide bandwidth, a high isolation and a good cross-polarization performance.
this paper presents a dual-band and dualpolarized SIW lens antenna with a wideband performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antenna element has a bandwidth of 1.8 GHz (K/Ka-band), a 3dB axial ratio of 2.2/1.6 dB, a cross polarization of 15.5 dB, and a gain of 13.3/13.5 dB.
we have developed a novel design for dual-band and dual-pol SIW lens antenna.
we have designed an OMT fed SIW lens antenna that operates at 20.2 and 28.3GHz with a cross-polarization level below -25dB in the E- and H-planes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed dual-band and dual polarized antenna can be integrated with the OMT and the feed network to realize a dual-band and dual-pol antenna for K/Ka band applications.
a dual-band and dualpolarized antenna with high cross-polarization suppression can be designed using a single OMT and an extended hemispheric lens.
a compact and low-cost antenna solution for dual-band and dual polarized applications can be achieved by combining the OMT and the SIW feed with a dielectric lens. Proc. SPI
